title: The Twin Suns Canon
summary: A canon of two suns held in step that guard and burn in pairs and end in a joining of both at once.

title: Treatise of Paired Dawn and Gilded Current
summary: A treatise on sun qi poured as a gilded current that heals along one bank and floods along the other.

title: The Basin Daystar Mastery
summary: A mastery of storing sun qi in the body like water in a basin and loosing it all in one overflow.

title: The Hawk Zenith Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of sun moves that watch from the height of noon and fall as a talon of light on the one chosen.

title: Canon of the Azure Corona
summary: A canon of the pale rim of fire round the sun that guards the user and burns outward under a clear sky.

title: The Windward Noon Canon
summary: A canon of high-sun moves set against the wind that burn off every cover and hold their ground to the last.

title: Treatise of the Oath-Anchored Sun
summary: A treatise on swearing the sun to a companion as an anchor and loosing the sworn fire on the oath-breaker.

title: The Open Sky Radiance Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of light spread across the whole open sky that dazzles and scours and leaves nothing hidden.

title: Manual of the Bearing Ray
summary: A manual of fixing a bearing with the sun and loosing a ray that holds the line to the target without fail.

title: Canon of the Unwalled Zenith
summary: A canon of the sun at its height with no wall or edge to it that fills the open field and the open sky with fire.
